unlisted_practices: LLM-agent extraction of unstructured clinical report data cross-validated by two independent clinical experts
ML-derived formula to impute missing clinical measurements (mean pulmonary artery pressure) to reduce underdiagnosis

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM agent-based pipeline to extract hemodynamic values from retrospective right heart catheterization reports and an ML formula to impute missing mPAP to automate diagnosis of pulmonary hypertension. It evaluates the performance of the newly developed tool but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
